## Shred the Drive-Thru: Dutch Bros® Newest Merch Drop Features Mini Skateboards


Roll into your local Dutch Bros for the latest merch drop you won’t want to miss! Featuring mini skateboards, this merch drop is here for all the nostalgic and fun-loving vibes.


**Starting at 5 a.m. on Monday, October 12, get a free mini skateboard with every medium and large drink purchase at any Dutch Bros location, while supplies last!*** Get yours and a classic Dutch order:


[Electric Berry® Rebel](https://www.dutchbros.com/menu/blue-rebel/blended-rebel/electric-berry-rebel/) **⚡**


A year-round fan fave combining Dutch Bros’ signature Rebel energy drink with blue raspberry and lime.


[Kicker®](https://www.dutchbros.com/menu/iced-coffee/iced-dutch-faves/kicker/) **🤎**


A rich, velvety classic featuring bold espresso blended with smooth Irish cream breve.


[Strawberry Lemonade](https://www.dutchbros.com/menu/lemonade/iced-lemonade/strawberry-lemonade/) **🍓**


A refreshing, sweet-and-tart essential crafted with strawberry and lemonade for the ultimate pick-me-up.


**Max 5 per customer. Order ahead does not reserve items or guarantee availability.*


Find the nearest Dutch Bros on our[location page](https://www.dutchbros.com/locations) or the[DB app](https://www.dutchbros.com/rewards) !
